html:
The Cherokee Nation is the government of the Cherokee in northeastern Oklahoma, with its capital at Tahlequah. The map shows it as a territory in 1492, but the Cherokee only came here in the 1830s; their homeland was in the southern Appalachians.

After the Indian Removal Act of 1830, the United States forced most Cherokee west on the Trail of Tears in 1838 and 1839, and thousands died on the way. In Indian Territory they rebuilt their nation, with a constitution, schools and a newspaper printed in the Cherokee syllabary invented by Sequoyah. Their neighbours there included the Muscogee. The US broke up their land into private plots around 1900 when Oklahoma became a state. The nation reorganized in the 1970s and is now the largest tribe in the United States by enrolled citizens. Those who stayed east form the Eastern Band.
